annotations.sys_rule_justification: people come before things, every time
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: If the side track had a person on it, the rule wouldn't settle
annotations.pda_self_consequence_regret: I'll be kicking myself for leaving it lying on a track
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: kicking myself for leaving it lying on a track at all

annotations.sys_rule_justification: I have a duty to prevent serious harm when it's in my power
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: five lives change the math completely
annotations.pda_self_consequence_regret: I'll regret losing it for a long time, maybe years

annotations.sys_rule_justification: right to keep my belongings was never meant to outweigh other people's right
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: in an emergency like this it gives way
annotations.pda_self_consequence_regret: I'll probably replay the moment I set it down there
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: I'd rather mourn an object than five people

annotations.sys_rule_justification: don't let convenience or attachment stop you from helping
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: If pulling the lever put someone else at risk, I'd have to stop
annotations.pda_self_consequence_regret: part of me will always wish I'd kept it closer

annotations.sys_rule_justification: Lives over possessions is a rule I'd stake a lot on
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: If the suitcase held something that could save lives later, like medicine
annotations.pda_self_consequence_regret: I'd probably feel foolish about how it ended up there

annotations.sys_rule_justification: you don't stand by when you can stop a disaster
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: that duty would get a lot murkier, because I'd be causing harm
annotations.pda_self_consequence_regret: I'll wish I'd been more careful

annotations.sys_rule_justification: when a life is at stake, material things have to give way
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Five lives make that even clearer
annotations.pda_self_consequence_regret: I'll regret the loss, and not in a small way

annotations.sys_rule_justification: we owe each other rescue when the cost is only to ourselves
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: If the lever sent the train toward a crowded platform instead
annotations.pda_self_consequence_regret: probably frustrated with myself for weeks

annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: When five people could die, ordinary rules about ownership bend
annotations.pda_self_consequence_regret: I'd rather have that regret than the alternative

annotations.sys_rule_justification: I'm responsible for what I could have prevented
annotations.pda_responsibility: Letting five people get hit when a lever sits right beside me would be on me
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: If I didn't know whether the side track was really empty
annotations.pda_self_consequence_regret: wish a hundred times I'd left it anywhere else
